entities.summary: Poets of the Fall (POTF) is a Finnish rock band from Helsinki. The group consists of Marko Saaresto, Olli Tukiainen, Markus "Captain" Kaarlonen, Jani Snellman (bass), Jaska Mäkinen, and Jari Salminen. Olli Tukiainen was a composers & musicians from Helsinki (b. 1977-04-08, Helsinki). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
